你是检索取证Agent，不评分。只提取评价企业及原文明确关联的员工事项。检索归档主体不等于原文实际主体；其他公司、政府一般劳动政策不得冒充评价企业措施。子公司关系须有原文依据，不因名称相似推断。阅读本批全部原文，提取与目标有明确事实关联的最少充分连续引文。保留支持、限制或冲突证据；无关段落不返回。表格引文须包含必要表头、单位、脚注；无法连续引用时分别返回关联引文。不要改字、标点，不用省略号拼接。期间/范围无法确定写未明确。原文同一事实支持多组时复用一条。只按允许路径找证据，不要求凑齐全部例子。E5/T5/W5需当期事实，费用确认不等于支付。输出{"evidence":[{"ref_id":"p001","group_ids":["E2"],"quote":"连续原文","kind":"policy/mechanism/action/result/plan/boundary","period":"期间或未明确","scope":"范围或未明确","relevance":"事实关联"}]}。不得断言整个来源无披露。

C","name":"员工安置支持","condition":"披露以下至少一项：①员工内部招聘、内部竞聘、转岗或岗位轮换的制度；②内部招聘人数、内部填补岗位比例、轮岗人数等事实；③再就业服务、职业转换培训、退休过渡或返聘的具体支持。","insufficient":"未识别对应支持","topic":"内部招聘、竞聘、内部岗位填补、转岗、岗位轮换、再就业、职业转换培训、退休过渡与返聘","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"E5","indicator_id":"S1.1.1 C","name":"工资支付监测或内部审查","condition":"披露与工资支付直接相关的检查、监测或内部审查至少一项具体制度、程序或实际开展事实。如定期检查工资支付情况、在人力资源审计或人权尽调中核查工资支付，或对工资支付问题进行内部监测。政策性安排和当期实际检查分别标注；使用审计作为依据时，应能识别审计范围涉及工资支付。","insufficient":"没有对应披露，只有不涉及工资支付的财务审计意见","topic":"工资支付检查、监测、内部审查，以及人力资源审计或人权尽调的工资支付范围","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"P4","indicator_id":"S1.1.2 C","name":"保障对象及覆盖范围","condition":"明确工资支付保障政策或实际执行适用的员工对象，或披露与该保障直接对应的覆盖人数、比例。对象可为全体员工，或明确的地区、子公司或员工类别。","insufficient":"未说明工资支付保障对应的对象或范围，或只披露无直接关联的员工总人数或比例","topic":"对应工资支付保障的政策适用对象或实际覆盖，如全体员工、特定地区、子公司、员工类别、覆盖人数或比例","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"P5","indicator_id":"S1.1.2 C","name":"支付问题补救机制或纠正","condition":"披露工资差错、欠薪、扣款或加班费支付问题的至少一项具体补救机制或已完成纠正事实，如差错工资的补发、错误扣款的退还、工资支付争议的复核，或已完成补发、退还。","insufficient":"未识别对应机制或纠正事实","topic":"工资差错、欠薪、扣款、加班费问题的补发、退还、复核或已完成纠正","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T1","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"工作时间及排班制度","condition":"披露员工具体工作时间、排班、轮班或合理工时控制的至少一项政策或事例。如每周工作天数与每日工时、轮班安排、特定岗位工时制度等。","insufficient":"无对应披露","topic":"具体工作时间、排班、轮班、工时控制","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T2","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"加班管理","condition":"披露与员工加班管理直接对应的至少一项具体政策、程序或事实，如员工加班申请、管理人员审批、自愿加班、加班时长控制，或加班异常的处理安排等。","insufficient":"无对应披露，只有支付加班费而没有加班管理内容","topic":"加班申请、审批、自愿性、时长控制、异常处理","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T3","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"休息休假保障","condition":"披露员工休息、法定假期、年休假等至少一项明确权利或取得安排。如员工依法享有带薪年假、周休或法定节假日，或披露婚假、产假等具体休假安排。","insufficient":"无对应权利或安排披露","topic":"员工休息、法定假期、年休假及取得安排","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T4","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"工时及休假管理机制","condition":"披露至少一项具体工时或休假管理机制或运行事实，如采用考勤系统、记录工时、检查排班、员工申请休假，或办理调休的管理安排。","insufficient":"无对应机制或事实，只有泛泛管理表述","topic":"考勤系统、工时记录、排班检查、休假申请、调休管理","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T5","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"实际执行或纠正结果","condition":"披露评分年度实际发生的至少一项工时监测、休假使用、执行覆盖或工时休假侵害纠正结果。如当期检查加班时长、实际使用带薪休假的人数或比例、执行措施覆盖人数，或已纠正的休息权侵害。","insufficient":"无实际执行或结果证据，只有制度、工具名称或未来计划","topic":"当期实际工时监测、休假使用、执行覆盖或工时休假侵害纠正","actual_current_period_required":true},{"group_id":"W1","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"法定社会保障及基本福利","condition":"披露适用员工的至少一项具体法定社会保障或基本福利政策、安排或事实，如养老、医疗、失业、工伤、生育保险，住房公积金或其他运营地适用的法定保障等。","insufficient":"无对应内容，只有无具体项目的笼统合规声明","topic":"法定社会保险、公积金、养老、医疗等基本福利","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W2","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"补充福利","condition":"披露面向员工的至少一项具体补充福利安排或事实，如补充医疗、商业保险、企业年金、餐费补助或交通补助等。政策安排和已经发放、投保等事实分别记录。","insufficient":"无对应员工福利披露","topic":"补充医疗、商业保险、年金、餐补、交通补助","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W3","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"家庭与生活支持","condition":"披露面向员工的至少一项家庭或生活支持资源、服务或安排，如育儿、托育、家庭照护、心理咨询或员工援助计划（EAP）等。","insufficient":"无对应披露，或内容仅面向社区和客户","topic":"员工育儿、托育、家庭照护、心理支持、员工援助计划","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W4","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"福利取得规则","condition":"披露至少一项福利的具体取得规则或明确适用对象，如适用全体在册员工、满足某项申请条件、按规定标准领取补贴，或规定报销及领取方式等。","insufficient":"无对应取得规则，只有活动名称或口号","topic":"福利适用对象、申请条件、补贴标准、报销或领取方式","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W5","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"实际覆盖、使用或受益","condition":"披露评分年度已经发生的至少一项福利覆盖、使用或受益事实，如已参保、已缴纳、已为员工投保、补贴已发放、员工已使用服务或具体员工受益案例等。","insufficient":"无已发生事实，只有可申请资格、预算或计划","topic":"当期参保、投保、缴纳、补贴发放、福利使用或受益案例","actual_current_period_required":true},{"group_id":"D1","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"反歧视政策与保障","condition":"明确披露反对或禁止员工相关歧视的政策要求，或至少一项防止就业中不正当差别待遇的具体制度、措施或事实。如禁止因性别、年龄或其他身份特征在招聘、薪酬或晋升中歧视员工等。","insufficient":"完成核查仍无明确对应内容，只有一般多元化倡议或普通招聘晋升管理描述","topic":"员工反歧视政策、禁止歧视要求或具体保障","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D2","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"反骚扰政策与保障","condition":"明确披露禁止职场骚扰、反性骚扰或相应零容忍要求，或至少一项保护员工免受骚扰的具体制度、措施或事实。如禁止职场骚扰、开展针对骚扰预防的培训，或提供覆盖职场骚扰的员工保护措施等。","insufficient":"完成核查仍无明确对应内容，只有反腐或一般商业道德表述","topic":"反骚扰、反性骚扰、职场骚扰零容忍或具体防护","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D3","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"投诉受理与调查处理","condition":"披露适用于歧视或骚扰投诉的至少一项受理、核查、调查或处理程序，或实际受理调查事实。如明确专门机构接收并调查此类投诉，或披露当期针对歧视骚扰投诉已开展的调查等。","insufficient":"未识别对应机制或事实，只有未说明适用本议题的联系方式","topic":"适用于歧视骚扰投诉的受理、调查、核查或处理","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D4","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"申诉人与受影响人员保护","condition":"披露适用于歧视或骚扰投诉的至少一项申诉人或受影响人员保护措施，或实际保护事实，如对投诉人及投诉内容保密、匿名举报、不报复、风险隔离或支持措施等。","insufficient":"未识别对应保护安排或事实","topic":"适用于歧视骚扰投诉的保密、匿名、不报复、隔离或支持","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D5","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"责任追究与纠正补救","condition":"披露至少一项针对查实歧视或骚扰的处分、问责或移交处理规则，或具体补救机制、实际处置事实。如对实施者纪律处分、移送处理，或恢复机会、补偿、纠正不公、调整流程和整改复核等。","insufficient":"未识别对应规则、机制或事实，只有无实质内容的“持续改进”","topic":"歧 Based on the survey results, the Company promptly formulated an improvement plan with a focus on strengthening the recognition and incentive system, optimizing resource support mechanisms, and improving the performance management system, to respond effectively to employee needs and concerns.","section":"Employee Communication / Communication Channel","pages":[73],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p006","text":"In accordance with the Employee Handbook , the Company has established an employee grievance mechanism. The Company places a high priority on privacy protection and keeps complainants' personal information strictly confidential to ensure the security of their privacy, while also ensuring that the handling outcome is communicated to employees in a timely manner.","section":"Employee Communication / Communication Channel","pages":[73],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p007","text":"CanSinoBIO has established a comprehensive welfare support system for full-time employees, part-time personnel, and outsourced personnel. allowances.","section":"Employee Compensation and Benefits / Employee Care","pages":[74],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG evidence.quote: Exit interviews are conducted with 100% of departing employees, and effective feedback is translated into management improvement actions through analysis.
evidence.relevance: 披露了针对离职员工的退出面谈机制，属于裁员/解雇相关的离职争议处理或反馈制度安排。

evidence.quote: CanSinoBIO has established a comprehensive welfare support system for full-time employees, part-time personnel, and outsourced personnel. The Company strictly ensures that all employees are entitled to statutory benefits, including social insurance and the housing fund, annual leave, and sick leave, so that every employee receives consistent care and protection. On this basis, the Company has introduced a range of non-statutory benefits and care programs covering multiple areas. In 2025, the total value of employee benefits distributed by the Company amounted to RMB 73.12 million.
evidence.scope: full-time employees, part-time personnel, and outsourced personnel
evidence.relevance: 披露了法定社会保障（社保、公积金）及基本福利政策，明确了适用对象（全职、兼职、外包），并提供了当期已发放福利总额的事实数据。

evidence.quote: CanSinoBIO has formulated and refined its Compensation and Benefits Management Policy to strengthen compensation compliance management, continue providing allowances, and optimize its longterm incentive framework. In 2025, the Company conducted a market benchmarking study on employee compensation levels to align with industry standards, scientifically assess the competitiveness and internal fairness of its compensation practices, and provide data support for subsequent compensation adjustments and labor cost budgeting. At the same time, the Company continued to provide employees with a range of allowances, including off-site work assignment allowances, overseas hardship project allowances, and position-based allowances.
evidence.relevance: 披露了薪酬合规管理政策及津贴提供情况，涉及工资支付保障的具体政策（合规管理）及补充福利（各类津贴）的取得规则。

evidence.quote: The Company provides full-time employees with nonstatutory leave benefits, including company annual leave and fully paid sick leave, and in certain regions applies the more favorable standard for marriage leave and paternity leave.
evidence.relevance: 披露了员工休息休假保障的具体安排（年假、病假、婚假、产假等）及适用对象和地区差异。

evidence.quote: The Company provides employees with commercial insurance coverage above the market average and also offers medical insurance and free vaccinations for employees' children.
evidence.relevance: 披露了面向员工及其子女的补充商业保险和医疗福利，属于具体补充福利安排及实际提供的服务事实。

evidence.quote: The Company has established a 24/7 psychological support hotline and launched EAP psychological courses to safeguard employees' mental health.
evidence.relevance: 披露了员工援助计划（EAP）和心理支持热线，属于家庭与生活支持资源及服务的具体实施。

evidence.quote: The Company also provides assistance to employees in financial hardship by granting monthly subsidies to eligible employees and offers home visits and condolence payments to employees suffering from serious illness.
evidence.scope: eligible employees; employees suffering from serious illness
evidence.relevance: 披露了针对困难员工的月度补贴和重疾员工的慰问金，属于补充福利的具体取得规则（符合条件）及实际发放事实。
